name: The Pointy End
summary:
A 3D auto battler of fighters in an arena. Fighters level up, have a large 'classless' overlapping passive tree. Fighters have skills based on their main and off hand. Fighters fight in the arena according to player specified tactics.

Async PvP Gauntlet against other player's teams or play the single player Champion Campaign to rise from the low leagues to the champions league or play the experimental Conqueror's Campaign to take over the continent.
